inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
echo '=== ADVERSARIAL ASOL CONTROL VERIFICATION ==='
git fetch --prune origin main
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = "main"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"

echo '--- route ownership / compatibility attack tests ---'
npm run api:inventory
npm run test:account-bridge
npm run test:api-core

echo '--- architectural isolation attack tests ---'
npm run test:architecture-core
npm run test:import-without-composition
npm run test:gova-deployment-core
npm run test:account-declarations
npm run env:ownership

echo '--- control runtime and release-plane attack tests ---'
npm run test:control
npm run test:deployment-tools
npm run test:vercel-deploy-core
npm run test:release-core

echo '--- construct gova-only deployment tree and attack its contents ---'
rm -rf .tmp-gova-build
npm run gova:tree
test -d .tmp-gova-build
if [ -d .tmp-gova-build/src/app/api ]; then
  bad_routes=$(find .tmp-gova-build/src/app/api -type f -name 'route.ts' ! -path '*/api/health/route.ts' -print)
  if [ -n "$bad_routes" ]; then
    echo 'FATAL: business API route implementations leaked into gova deployment tree:'
    printf '%s\n' "$bad_routes"
    exit 71
  fi
fi
npm run gova:artifact:verify

echo '--- full regression gates ---'
npm run typecheck
npm run lint
npm run architecture:check
npm run docs:ci
npm run verify:all
npm run test

echo '--- final fail-closed state ---'
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
rm -rf .tmp-gova-build
echo 'ADVERSARIAL_VERIFICATION=PASS'
